answer_1.quote: INSTRUCTDIAL consists of multiple dialogue tasks converted into a text-to-text format (Figure ). These dialogue tasks cover generation, classification, and evaluation for both task-oriented and open-ended settings and are drawn from different domains (Figure ).
answer_1.outputs: generated responses in a sequence-to-sequence format with task-specific constraints and instructions

answer_2.quote: For the generation tasks we also report the automatic metric GRADE (which has shown good correlation with human ratings on response coherence).

answer_3.quote: Given a dialogue context and a candidate response, we instruct the model to predict "yes" if the response is relevant to the context, otherwise predict "no". We calculate the probability of "yes" as p(yes) = p(yes)/(p(yes) + p(no)). We calculate the Spearman correlation of the model's prediction with human ratings for relevance provided in the DSTC-10 test sets
